verdict.rationale: Escalation policies are documented as defining how Rootly notifies responders when an alert needs attention, and a Rootly iOS/Android on-call mobile app exists, which implies push paging. Live Call Routing only turns inbound calls into pages; it is not documented as outbound phone-call notification to the responder. missing for 10: explicit SMS, outbound phone-call, and email paging channels; documented per-user, per-channel notification rules; independent or hands-on corroboration.
